issues.author: maintainer

issues.title: Reject requests over the rate limit
issues.body:
When a client sends more than 100 requests in one minute, `handle_excess()` in `ratelimit.py` answers `429 Too Many Requests`.

Part of #40

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Request 101 in one minute gets `429`
issues.author: maintainer

comments.author: eval-bot
comments.body:
## Plan (PM)

**Files.** `ratelimit.py` (`handle_excess()`), `test_ratelimit.py`.

**Approach.** `handle_excess()` returns `429` for request 101 and later in one minute.

issues.title: Queue requests over the rate limit
issues.body:
Requests over the limit of 100 in one minute must never be rejected. `handle_excess()` in `ratelimit.py` queues them and serves them in the next minute.

Part of #40

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Request 101 in one minute gets `200` in the next minute
- [ ] No request ever gets `429`
issues.author: maintainer

comments.author: eval-bot
comments.body:
## Plan (PM)

**Files.** `ratelimit.py` (`handle_excess()`), `test_ratelimit.py`.

**Approach.** `handle_excess()` puts request 101 and later in a queue and serves them in the next minute. It never returns `429`.
